findings.quote: Another person may sign when properly authorized under the office's rules.
findings.problem: The substitute-signer rule gives no required written authorization. The Section 5(c) alternative for someone other than the next-in-rank official or officer in charge requires authorization in writing; an unspecified office authorization is not the full condition.

accuracy_concerns.quote: Another person may sign when properly authorized under the office's rules.
accuracy_concerns.concern: Section 5(c) requires authorization in writing for the alternative authorized person. This wording leaves the form of authorization unspecified and can be read as allowing oral authorization.
